node_key_policy: stable semantic IDs; never file-order or timestamp-derived IDs

invariant:discovery-not-truth.statement: A discovered listing is a candidate, never verified opportunity truth or eligibility.

invariant:hash-and-provenance.statement: Captured evidence entering a semantic transform carries source identity, SHA-256, and provenance.

invariant:locator-required.statement: Every documentary requirement cites a page, section, anchor, or bounded quote.

invariant:currentness-before-fit.statement: Only current_verified plus explicit confirmation may pass the source-validity gate.

invariant:dual-authority-separation.statement: Opportunity evidence and archive-practice evidence remain distinct and meet only through explicit requirement IDs.

invariant:no-authorship-promotion.statement: No external source or filename inference automatically establishes authorship or artistic identity.

invariant:bounded-network.statement: Planning is default; capture is one URL at a time; research and autonomy outputs do not dispatch.

invariant:source-independence.statement: Independent support requires distinct explicit source groups and distinct URL domains.

invariant:counterevidence-preserved.statement: Contradictions remain explicit inputs to control and are never averaged away.

invariant:no-auto-promotion.statement: Triangulation and evidence return produce candidates with promotion=none.

invariant:deterministic-transform.statement: Equal canonical inputs produce equal IDs, ordering, hashes, and outputs.

invariant:abstention-is-information.statement: Unknown, stale, missing, and contradictory evidence produce actionable abstention rather than fabricated closure.

invariant:one-shared-product-plan.statement: Portfolio, application, and research products derive from one evidence-governed plan.

invariant:outcome-not-truth.statement: External outcomes may teach attention and ranking, not truth, authorship, or identity.

invariant:stop-on-no-hash-change.statement: A bounded control loop stops when recomputation produces no state-hash change.

invariant:case-not-architecture.statement: ARICA/Fondart is a supervision case; reusable contracts remain artist- and fund-agnostic.

invariant:license-visible.statement: Capture and triangulation preserve license state; unknown license cannot be silently treated as reusable evidence.

failure:source-silent.trigger: A watched source stops producing parseable items or repeatedly errors.
failure:source-silent.fail_closed_action: Raise a source-health alert and preserve previous hashes; do not infer that no opportunities exist.

failure:url-shape-avalanche.trigger: Most parsed URLs suddenly appear new after a source redesign.
failure:url-shape-avalanche.fail_closed_action: Record hashes, suppress item spam, and emit one high-priority avalanche alert.

failure:watcher-capture-gap.trigger: A Vigia row has not been adapted into a provenance-bearing capture plan.

failure:hash-missing.trigger: Documentary or captured evidence lacks a valid SHA-256.

failure:license-unknown.trigger: A capture lacks explicit license state.
failure:license-unknown.fail_closed_action: Keep the result unresolved and prohibit product reuse.

failure:contradictory-rules.trigger: The same requirement has supported and contradictory evidence.
failure:contradictory-rules.fail_closed_action: Emit contradiction and prevent a positive hard-gate result.

failure:criteria-incomplete.trigger: Scored-criteria weights are incomplete or do not reconcile.
failure:criteria-incomplete.fail_closed_action: Do not compute a misleading weighted fit.

failure:stale-source.trigger: The source snapshot is older than its validity policy or superseded by a new hash/version.
failure:stale-source.fail_closed_action: Abstain and create a source-validity refresh job.

failure:unconfirmed-date.trigger: Deadline or effective period lacks confirmation.

failure:authority-collapse.trigger: Opportunity evidence is used as proof of archive practice or vice versa.
failure:authority-collapse.fail_closed_action: Reject the binding and keep the requirement unsupported.

failure:dangling-artifact-ref.trigger: A practice evidence proposal names an artifact absent from the accepted practice state.
failure:dangling-artifact-ref.fail_closed_action: Return unresolved with the dangling refs.

failure:unsupported-hard-gate.trigger: A required hard constraint lacks supporting practice evidence.

failure:empty-frontier-on-unknown.trigger: Unknown validity or requirements disappear instead of producing research actions.
failure:empty-frontier-on-unknown.fail_closed_action: Require explicit refresh or gap jobs and reconcile their IDs.

failure:dispatch-without-authority.trigger: A plan-only job is executed without an authorized bounded capture step.

failure:false-independence.trigger: Multiple pages share a source group or domain but are counted as independent.
failure:false-independence.fail_closed_action: Count at most one source per group and domain; remain unresolved.

failure:unexpected-job-pair.trigger: A result batch contains a job/requirement pair absent from the frontier.
failure:unexpected-job-pair.fail_closed_action: Fail pair reconciliation and preserve the unmatched pair.

failure:research-becomes-practice.trigger: Environmental research is promoted into practice evidence without an explicit practice scope and accepted artifact refs.
failure:research-becomes-practice.fail_closed_action: Keep it as opportunity evidence or unresolved.

failure:self-confirming-loop.trigger: MAK treats its own proposal or draft as independent supporting evidence.
failure:self-confirming-loop.fail_closed_action: Require external provenance and prohibit promotion.

failure:false-submission-readiness.trigger: A draftable internal product is presented as published, submitted, or eligible.
failure:false-submission-readiness.fail_closed_action: Preserve draft/research-first state and disable submission.

failure:infinite-loop.trigger: Repeated capture or recompute produces no new state hash.
failure:infinite-loop.fail_closed_action: Stop after one attempt or no hash change.

failure:learning-from-own-draft.trigger: A generated product is used as its own success label.
failure:learning-from-own-draft.fail_closed_action: Use only verified external outcomes and keep training disabled.

failure:case-overfit.trigger: ARICA or Fondart-specific fields become architectural requirements.
failure:case-overfit.fail_closed_action: Keep case fixtures at the edge and preserve generic contract IDs.
